purpose: Validate reuse of the accepted normalized profile factor for Operator-PCG actions, compare ownership lifetimes, and measure the current COLAMD search-memory frontier.

selection.reason: Cube-512 establishes the first completed search comparison; reuse at cube-1024 retained the same trajectory with RSS margin under 4 GiB, so cube-2048 was measured next.

configuration.scope: search-only; no returned-state assessment or endpoint qualification
configuration.factor_representation: exported-fixed for DedicatedFixed and reuse; native-qr only for saved DedicatedNative references

provenance_notes: The 512 test-only prototype reports were run with candidate source contents that now match commit 5836a4a, as verified by source_sha256; the benchmark script observed the preceding ac1ed566 HEAD because the prototype changes were not yet committed at run time.

The 1024 DedicatedFixed completed reference is from source commit 5eb13f8. A fresh same-head rerun is retained and hit rss_limit in spqr-fixed-factor; its failed status is not used as a trajectory baseline.
The same-head 1024 reuse report is source commit 5836a4a. The 2048 reuse reports are source commit dbe1fb3.
The ownership analyzer preserves stage/factor telemetry nested inside failed repetition records; missing search trajectory on resource-stopped cases is not treated as parity.

decision.ownership_prototype_promotion_gate: passed for measured completed 512 and 1024 searches: action/rank/trajectory/lifetime parity, material RSS reduction, and no search-time regression.
decision.2048_frontier: remains RSS-limited during trial SPQR numeric factorization under the unchanged 4 GiB / 600 s envelope; both profiles overlap two workspace factors. No 2048 trajectory parity is claimed.
decision.factor_count_interpretation: Accepted-factor reuse removes the separate operator factor, but trial evaluation still overlaps the accepted profile factor; peak factor count is two.
decision.two_level_schwarz: not investigated; the existing synthetic multi-block gate remains stable.
